name: timezone
rule: valid IANA zone; drives local-date derivation

name: course_status
rule: draft => no cohorts/enrolments; archived => all cohorts closed

name: access_end_date
rule: = end_date + grace_days (14); events after it are invalid

name: from_status
allowed: {enrolled, active, completed, dropped, expired} or null

name: parent_content_id
rule: null iff hierarchy_level=1; parent must be same course

name: content_type
allowed: {module, video, reading, discussion, quiz, assignment, final_exam}

name: course_order
rule: global order within course; unique per course

name: is_required
rule: video/reading always true; discussion false; assessments follow assessments.is_required

name: weight_pct
rule: weights of a course sum to exactly 100

name: is_late
rule: true iff submitted after due date end (UTC)

name: effective_from
rule: rule applies to cohorts with start_date in [from, to]

name: effective_to
rule: no gaps/overlaps between versions of a course

name: min_required_content_pct
rule: share of REQUIRED video/reading items with a completion event

name: event_id
rule: prefix = enrollment_id; seq reflects insertion order

name: enrollment_id
rule: violations are labelled in ground truth (unenrolled_activity)

name: event_type
allowed: {session_start, content_view, video_play, video_complete, content_complete, assessment_start, assessment_submit, discussion_post, resource_download}

name: client_tz_offset_min
rule: UTC offset of the learner at event time

name: source
rule: offline_sync => queued on device, uploaded later

name: duration_sec
rule: session length / watch time / assessment time

name: client_event_key
rule: client idempotency key; duplicates share it; dedup key

name: required_content_items_total
rule: count of required video/reading items in course

name: required_content_items_completed
rule: distinct required items with a completion event

name: required_assessments_passed
rule: distinct required assessments with a passing attempt

name: active_days
rule: distinct local dates with a valid event

name: active_weeks
rule: distinct cohort-relative weeks with a valid event

name: completion_status
rule: completed iff all three CompletionRule thresholds met

name: completed_at
rule: max of the three conditions' first-satisfied times; null unless completed

name: engagement_band
rule: inactive iff valid_event_count=0 else by active_weeks share
